rules.when: prediction.deadline is explicit and gold.deadline is unknown or no valid evidence supports it
prediction changes the source boundary, timezone, or precision of a deadline
prediction expands, reverses, or ignores a gold audience inclusion/exclusion condition
prediction marks a material required without a gold requirement and valid evidence
prediction adds a platform or entry point absent from gold and valid evidence
prediction merges two or more distinct gold stage/action deadlines
prediction removes a gold condition or exception from an action
prediction converts a recommendation, option, or reminder into a required action
prediction converts a possibility or unresolved uncertainty into a certain fact
prediction emits a certain action/deadline while the gold source conflict remains unresolved
prediction keeps a revoked or superseded action active
